violations.description: Date marking and disposition of ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food. — --Refrigerated, ready-to-eat potentially hazardous food (prepared more than 24 hours ago) was not properly date marked. Multiple food items in the refrigerated prep tables were found not date marked. Potentially hazardous food items should be date marked so proper disposition can occur.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Nonfood contact surface was not cleaned as frequently as required. Inside of the 3 door reach-in cooler in the server area was found dirty. This should be cleaned and maintained clean.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --Employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. Bottle of medication found on top of microwave in server area. Employee's home canned salsa found in 3 door reach-in cooler. Employee beverages found on prep counters in the kitchen and inside the three door cooler in the serving area. Employee personal items should be stored away from food prep and storage areas.

Preventing contamination from equipment, utensils, and wiping cloths. — --Cloth for wiping food spills was not stored in sanitizing solution (at proper concentration) between uses. Sanitizing solution in wiping cloth bucket was found at 0ppm. Wiping cloths stored in solutions using quaternary ammonia should be maintained according to manufacturer directions. Observed food employee wiping part of a table top, then wiping a chair and then back to the table with the same cloth until the top and chairs were all wiped. Separate cloths should be used for the tops and tables unless top is wiped and then the chairs, then laundered.

Cleaning frequency of equipment and utensils. — --Equipment that dispenses liquid/food/ice in unpackaged form was not cleaned properly and/or as frequently as required. Beverage dispenser was found dirty during inspection. This should be cleaned more thoroughly.

Storage of cleaned equipment and utensils. — --Clean equipment/utensil was not stored in a clean, dry manner to protect from contamination. Clean lids were stored in dirty containers below stainless prep table. Clean equipment should be stored in a clean location.

Handwashing lavatories. — --Handwashing lavatory was not provided in sufficient number and/or not accessible to allow convenient use by employees. Hand washing sink near the server station was found with an empty sanitizing bucket overturned over the basin. Hand washing sinks should be easily accessible.

Employee dressing areas and lockers. — --Employees' clothing/possessions were in an area where contamination of food, equipment, utensils, linens or single-service items may occur. Observed employee phone and beverage on shelving unit above prep area. Personal items should be stored separate from food prep areas.
Method, clean, temp, concentration, exposure time, equipment/utensils sanitized (4 pts deducted)
Clean, employee dressing area, cleaning equipment storage, living/sleeping quarters separate (1 pt deducted)
Provided as required, designed, constructed, installed, maintained, and cleaned (1 pt deducted)
